adjudication_rule: Thresholds are evidence flags, not automatic truth. Reviewers must resolve conflicting scope, phase and geography evidence and cite the determination. Unknown values cannot be treated as zero.
materiality_indicators: Documented hyperscale, wholesale, AI/HPC, cloud-region or multi-building campus use
Nameplate or planned critical load of at least 10 megawatts
Documented capital investment of at least 100 million nominal dollars
At least 100,000 square feet of dedicated data-center development
Project-specific tax abatement, bond, utility agreement or public infrastructure commitment
Evidence of construction activity or employment large enough to plausibly affect county outcomes
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not infer E0 from absence in a national registry.
Do not use a project announcement, opening ceremony, lease date or page-history anchor as the county's first material exposure without adjudication.
Do not classify a headquarters address as a data-center facility without facility evidence.
Do not convert missing megawatts, investment, square footage, incentives or dates to zero.
purpose: Separate literal evidence of any dedicated data-center activity from economically material commercial treatment so the study can publish a strict control specification and a disclosed sensitivity specification.
sensitivity_control_rule: A separately reported sensitivity model may admit E1 counties only when the documented facility predates the baseline, is not marketed commercially, lacks evidence of material economic scale and passes spillover review.
strict_control_rule: Only E0 counties with completed dated negative-evidence reviews through the treated county's event date may enter the primary donor pool.

tiers.causal_role: Eligible for the strict donor pool only after all negative-evidence domains and regional spillover checks are complete.
tiers.definition: No operating, construction, permitted, proposed, cancelled, pre or site-specific developer-approach evidence found through the required search domains as of the applicable treatment date.
tiers.label: No documented dedicated data-center exposure

tiers.causal_role: Excluded from the strict donor pool; may enter a prespecified sensitivity pool after spillover and scale review.
tiers.definition: A separately identified government, education, health-care or enterprise-computing facility is documented, but no evidence establishes a marketed colocation operation or economically material commercial development.
tiers.label: Accessory or institutional exposure only

tiers.causal_role: Excluded from strict and sensitivity donor pools.
tiers.definition: A dedicated commercial hosting, colocation or edge facility is documented, without evidence sufficient to classify it as a major campus-scale investment.
tiers.label: Commercial edge or colocation exposure

tiers.causal_role: Treatment exposure; requires a separately adjudicated county first-material-exposure date.
tiers.definition: A hyperscale, wholesale, AI/HPC or campus-scale development is documented, or public evidence establishes material capital investment, utility load, land/building scale, incentives or construction activity capable of affecting county outcomes.
tiers.label: Economically material commercial exposure
